column2: Irish Finity (Hyde Irish Whiskey / Hibernia Distillers, Innishannon, West Cork) is a honey-infused Irish malt whiskey spirit drink, not whiskey -- irishmalts.com itself categorizes it under "irish-spirits" (as it does Irish Mist) rather than "irish-whiskey" (where it lists genuine whiskeys like Element), and its own product page describes it explicitly as "a premium small batch spirit drink of Irish Malt Whiskey infused with...honey" -- the same category as Irish Mist/Bushmills Irish Honey, honey spirit drinks rather than whiskey.
